title: rig stack manifest
description: A fused workspace of upstream forks: each repo's history imported under a prefix of one git history through josh's reversible filters. See docs/STACK-DESIGN.md.

josh.description: josh engine version tag this workspace pins (e.g. r26.07.19). Defaults to the version pinned in rig. Changing it against existing workspace history is at your own risk.

branchPrefix.description: Prepended to the name `rig stack send` is given, so `send lib read-timeout` creates stack/read-timeout. Defaults to "stack/"; set to "" for bare names. A repo entry may override it.

repos.description: One entry per fused project; the key is the prefix directory its history lives under.

upstream.description: Canonical repo as host/owner/name (no scheme, no .git). PRs land here.

fork.description: Your fork as host/owner/name. `rig stack send` pushes extracted branches here.

upstreamBranch.description: Branch of `upstream` this directory follows — what `pull` takes and what `send` roots on. Defaults to main. Not the branch `send` creates; you name that per change.

branch.description: Deprecated name for upstreamBranch. Still read; prefer upstreamBranch, which cannot be confused with the branch `send` creates.

branchPrefix.description: Overrides the workspace branchPrefix for this project. Set to "" to send bare names to this fork only.

lastSync.description: Written by import and pull, not by hand: the full upstream commit each repo was last taken from.

additionalProperties.description: Full 40-character commit SHA. An abbreviated one never matches the remote tip.
